releaseNotes.it-IT: Le lobby amichevoli online accolgono fino a 8 giocatori: si parte quando tutti sono pronti, i turni passano in ordine e chi esce lascia gli altri a giocare. La classificata resta 1 contro 1.
releaseNotes.en-US: Online friendly lobbies now hold up to 8 players: the game starts when everyone is ready, turns rotate in order, and when someone leaves the others carry on. Ranked stays 1v1.
releaseNotes.en-GB: Online friendly lobbies now hold up to 8 players: the game starts when everyone is ready, turns rotate in order, and when someone leaves the others carry on. Ranked stays 1v1.
